site.summary: shopify-clone Clone of the Shopify marketing → trial → admin funnel. Pages | File | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `index.html` | Home: hero ("Your business starts with Shopify" + email signup input), product features, customer success stories, customer logos, footer | | `pricing.html` | Plan comparison: Basic / Shopify / Advanced three tiers, monthly / yearly toggle, feature comparison table, FAQ | | `free-trial.html` | Trial landing page: 3-step intro to the trial flow, value props restated, large "Start free trial" button |

explored_user_goal: Autonomously explore and critique the UX of the full shopify system, prioritizing the primary form/onboarding flow plus adjacent pages, states, and recovery paths.
exploration_summary: The Shopify onboarding flow has critical UX issues, especially with the 'Skip' link functionality failing repeatedly, mobile tap target warnings, and inconsistent 'Start free trial' button behavior. Coverage is low (10% of interactive features tested), leaving many untested areas like admin login options and form validations.

exploration_plan.goal: Explore and critique the UX of the Shopify system, focusing on the primary onboarding flow (home → trial form → admin) and adjacent pages (pricing, help, resources, sales) across desktop and mobile viewports.
exploration_plan.summary: The exploration will proceed in phases: 1) Validate the home page's onboarding entry points and mobile tap targets. 2) Test the free trial form flow and recovery paths. 3) Explore the admin login and error states. 4) Review pricing, resources, and help pages. 5) Assess the sales form and mobile responsiveness. Each phase will check interactables, layout warnings, and cross-viewport consistency.
assumptions: The primary flow is home → free-trial-form → admin. Adjacent flows include pricing, resources, help, and sales. Layout warnings (small tap targets) are critical for mobile UX. All pages load without errors (per prescan).
risk_hotspots: Small tap targets on navigation links (e.g., Solutions, Pricing, Resources) across all pages. Free-trial-form.html for potential form validation issues. Admin.html for login error states. Sales.html for missing input labels (per prescan layout warnings).

phases.title: Home Page & Onboarding Entry
phases.objective: Validate the home page's onboarding controls, mobile tap targets, and navigation links.
key_checks: Test 'Start free trial' button (desktop/mobile) and email input. Verify navigation links (Solutions, Pricing, Resources, Log in) are clickable and have sufficient tap targets on mobile. Check layout warnings for small tap targets. Confirm cross-viewport consistency (hero section, form, customer logos).
exit_criteria: All primary onboarding controls (email input, Start free trial button) are functional. Navigation links are clickable. Mobile tap targets for navigation links are ≥44x44px (or layout warnings are documented). Cross-viewport layout is consistent.

phases.title: Free Trial Form Flow
phases.objective: Test the free-trial-form.html flow, form fields, and recovery paths (e.g., skipping questions).
key_checks: Interact with form fields (e.g., business type, location). Test 'Next' and 'Skip all' buttons. Verify mobile tap targets for form controls. Check for form validation (e.g., required fields). Confirm transition to admin.html (or error handling if incomplete).
exit_criteria: Form controls (buttons, inputs) are functional. 'Skip all' works. Mobile tap targets meet guidance. Form validation (if any) is clear. Transition to admin.html (or error state) is consistent across viewports.

phases.title: Admin Login & Error States
phases.objective: Validate the admin login form, alternative login methods (Apple, Google, Facebook), and error states (e.g., incorrect credentials).
key_checks: Test email, password, and store URL inputs. Test 'Log in' button, 'Forgot password?', and social login buttons. Verify mobile tap targets for login controls. Check for error states (e.g., invalid credentials) and recovery paths (e.g., password reset).
exit_criteria: Login form controls are functional. Social login buttons work (or are placeholders). Error states (if triggered) are clear. Mobile tap targets meet guidance. Password reset link is functional.

phases.title: Adjacent Pages: Pricing, Help, Resources
phases.objective: Explore pricing tiers, help content, and resources, checking interactables and mobile tap targets.
key_checks: Test 'Start free trial' buttons on pricing. Verify plan comparison tables (pricing.html). Check help article links (help-trial.html). Test resource links (e.g., Blog, Tools, Events) on resources.html. Validate mobile tap targets for all interactables. Check layout warnings (small tap targets) on navigation and content links.
exit_criteria: All primary interactables (e.g., plan buttons, help links, resource links) are functional. Mobile tap targets meet guidance. Layout warnings are documented. Cross-viewport layout is consistent for tables (pricing.html) and content sections.

phases.title: Sales Form & Final Checks
phases.objective: Test the sales form (sales.html) for input labels, validation, and mobile responsiveness. Confirm cross-viewport consistency for all pages.
key_checks: Test form fields (name, email, company, size, phone, topic). Verify 'Submit' button. Check for missing input labels (per prescan layout warnings). Validate mobile tap targets for form controls. Confirm cross-viewport layout for all target pages (desktop/mobile).
exit_criteria: Sales form controls are functional. Input labels are present (or warnings are documented). Mobile tap targets meet guidance. All target pages have consistent layout across viewports.

coverage_targets.pages: Visit all 7 target pages (index, free-trial-form, admin, pricing, help-trial, resources, sales).
coverage_targets.features: Exercise all primary onboarding controls (2x 'Start free trial', email input), form controls (free-trial-form, sales), login controls (admin), and 80% of navigation/content links (e.g., Solutions, Pricing, Resources, help links, resource links).
coverage_targets.mobile: Repeat critical checks (e.g., tap targets, form usability, layout consistency) on mobile viewport for all target pages.

notes: Use the prescan's layout warnings (e.g., small tap targets, missing labels) as test cases. Prioritize the primary flow (home → free-trial-form → admin) first, then adjacent pages. Document all layout warnings and functional issues for critique.

findings.user_goal: Skip a step in the free trial onboarding form to proceed faster.
findings.problem: The 'Skip' link in the free trial form repeatedly failed to be clicked (timeout errors, no target ID), preventing users from skipping steps and recovering from unwanted form progression.
findings.evidence: Multiple attempts to click 'Skip' failed with timeouts or no target ID, and the form remained on the same step. The 'Skip' element was visible but interactability failed.
findings.why_it_matters: Users who want to skip questions (e.g., to proceed quickly) can't, causing frustration and blocking the onboarding flow. This breaks the recovery path UX.
findings.suggestion: Fix the 'Skip' link's interactability (e.g., correct locator, ensure it's not disabled) and test thoroughly across viewports. Add visual feedback (e.g., loading state) when 'Skip' is clicked.

findings.user_goal: Click the 'Shopify' link or 'Start free trial' button on mobile.
findings.problem: Mobile tap targets (e.g., 'Shopify' link, 'Start free trial' button) have small sizes (e.g., 123x35px < 44px guidance), violating mobile usability standards and increasing misclicks.
findings.evidence: Layout warnings show 'Shopify' link has 123x35px tap target, and 'Start free trial' button had inconsistent behavior (delayed navigation, 'Starting...' text).
findings.why_it_matters: Small tap targets on mobile make it hard to click accurately, reducing usability and increasing user frustration. Inconsistent button behavior confuses users about progress.
findings.suggestion: Increase tap target sizes to meet mobile guidance (≥44px), test button behavior for immediate navigation, and add clear loading feedback when 'Start free trial' is clicked.

findings.user_goal: Start the free trial by clicking 'Start free trial' on mobile.
findings.problem: The 'Start free trial' button on mobile showed 'Starting...' text but didn't immediately navigate to the form, causing confusion about whether the action succeeded.
findings.evidence: After clicking the button, the text changed to 'Starting...' and navigation to free-trial-form.html was delayed or required waiting, unlike desktop behavior.
findings.why_it_matters: Users may think the button failed or the app is broken, leading to abandonment. Inconsistent behavior across viewports reduces trust.
findings.suggestion: Ensure the 'Start free trial' button navigates immediately to free-trial-form.html on mobile (no 'Starting...' delay) or add a clear loading indicator and progress feedback.

findings.problem: The 'Shopify' link on mobile has a small tap target (123x35px) below the 44px minimum, violating accessibility and mobile usability standards.
findings.evidence: Layout warnings confirm the 'Shopify' link's tap target size is 123x35px, which is smaller than the recommended 44px for mobile touch targets.
findings.why_it_matters: Visually impaired or motor-impaired users struggle to click small targets, reducing accessibility. All users are more likely to misclick.
findings.suggestion: Increase the 'Shopify' link's tap target size to at least 44px (e.g., adjust padding) and test on mobile devices.

findings.user_goal: Submit the sales form to send an enquiry.
findings.problem: The 'How can we help?' dropdown in the sales form failed to expand when clicked, preventing users from selecting a topic before submission.
findings.evidence: Clicking the dropdown (target_id: ux-11) showed no visible expansion of options, indicating a functionality issue.
findings.why_it_matters: Users can't complete the sales form correctly, leading to failed submissions or incorrect data. This breaks the form's usability.
findings.suggestion: Fix the dropdown's expand functionality (e.g., ensure JavaScript triggers on click) and add visual feedback (e.g., dropdown arrow rotation) when expanded.

findings.user_goal: Start the free trial from the index page on mobile.
findings.problem: The 'Start free trial' button on mobile initially showed 'Starting...' and delayed navigation to free-trial-form.html, causing confusion about whether the action was successful.
findings.evidence: After clicking, the button text changed to 'Starting...' and navigation was delayed until a wait action triggered it. This inconsistent behavior differs from desktop.
findings.why_it_matters: Users may abandon the flow thinking it's broken. Delayed navigation without feedback reduces trust and usability.
findings.suggestion: Ensure immediate navigation to free-trial-form.html on mobile (or add a clear loading state) and test the button's behavior across viewports.

findings.user_goal: Complete the free trial form and see progress.
findings.problem: The free trial form lacks clear visual feedback (e.g., step indicators, progress bar) to show users their position in the multi-step flow.
findings.evidence: The form shows steps (e.g., 'What are you planning to sell?') but no visual progress indicator (e.g., 1/5 steps) to help users track their progress.
findings.why_it_matters: Users feel lost in the multi-step flow, reducing engagement and increasing drop-off. Clear progress feedback improves usability.
findings.suggestion: Add a progress bar or step indicator (e.g., 'Step 1 of 5') to the free trial form to show users their position and remaining steps.
